faq.sub: Everything owners and managers ask before switching to Smart Restaurant.
faq.q1: Do my customers need to install anything?
faq.q1a: No. Guests scan the QR code on their table and the menu opens in their phone browser — no app, no signup, on any phone.
faq.q2a: Most venues go live in one day: we load your menu, print your table QR codes, and train your team the same afternoon.
faq.q3: What happens after the 30-day free trial?
faq.q3a: You choose a plan to continue. If you don't, your account pauses — your menu and data stay safe until you return.
faq.q4a: Yes — upgrade or downgrade anytime; the change applies to your next billing cycle.
faq.q5: Are there commissions on my orders?
faq.q5a: No. Smart Restaurant charges a flat monthly fee per venue — 0% commission, you keep every franc.
faq.q6: Which payment methods can my guests use?
faq.q6a: Cash, cards, and mobile money — all recorded automatically with daily reports.
faq.q7a: An engraved wooden menu holder with space for salt, chili and toothpicks (12,000 RWF/table), a plastic holder with salt & chili space (5,000 RWF/table), or free waterproof QR stickers.
faq.q8: Can I add more tables or menu items later?
faq.q8a: Yes. Starter covers 10 tables and 50 menu items, Pro covers 40 tables and 200 items, and Enterprise is unlimited — upgrade whenever you grow.
faq.q9: Which languages does the menu support?
faq.q9a: English, French, Kinyarwanda and Kiswahili — guests switch language themselves on their phone.
faq.q10a: Yes. Smart Restaurant is GDPR and Rwanda Data Protection Law compliant; your sales data belongs to you.
faq.ctaBody: Start a free trial or talk to our team — we answer the same day.

legal.privacy1: Smart Restaurant is operated by Inovasiyo Ltd in Rwanda. We collect account details, restaurant operations data (orders, tables, staff activity), and technical logs needed to run the service.
legal.privacy2: Guest QR sessions are tied to a table, not a named diner, unless staff record a name or phone for an order. We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacy3: Restaurant staff can access their tenant’s data. Platform administrators may access data to provide support, prevent abuse, and meet legal duties.
legal.privacy4: To request access, correction, or deletion, email info\@inovasiyo.rw. Cookie preferences can be declined on first visit; essential cookies keep the staff session working.
legal.terms1: By creating an account or using a table QR code you agree to these terms. The platform is provided as-is for restaurant operations in Rwanda.
legal.terms2: Restaurants are responsible for menu prices, tax, staff access, and the accuracy of recorded payments. Payment gateways are not included; staff record cash, card, and mobile money by hand.
legal.terms3: We may suspend accounts that abuse the service, attempt to access another restaurant’s data, or violate applicable law.
legal.terms4: These terms are governed by the laws of Rwanda. Contact Inovasiyo Ltd at info\@inovasiyo.rw.
